content.en: Public Sector Enterprises are organizations where the government holds at least 51% of the paid-up share capital. They are categorized into **Departmental Undertakings**, **Statutory Corporations**, and **Government Companies** based on their legal structure and autonomy.
content.hi: Public Sector Enterprises are organizations where the government holds at least 51% of the paid-up share capital. They are categorized into **Departmental Undertakings**, **Statutory Corporations**, and **Government Companies** based on their legal structure and autonomy.

definition.en: The degree of operational and financial freedom granted to the management.
definition.hi: The degree of operational and financial freedom granted to the management.

content.en: A performance-based classification system that grants greater financial and operational autonomy to high-performing PSEs.
